messages:
nina-partnerships: Quick thread  we need to finalize the minimal artifact set for the marketplace listing AND coordinate the customer-facing launch blurb. Focus: AWS/GCP/Azure initial onboarding (not pricing), and a short joint announcement plan.

owen-cloud: For onboarding artifacts: EULA PDF, manifest.json, support_url, asset bundle, publisher_id, offer_alias. I'll add a small script to validate manifest paths.

tess-legal: I'll provide a single EULA PDF and two compliant copy variants: one for EU data-residency wording and one for global. Also confirm we can use the same support_url across clouds.

mike-product: For the announcement copy, let's keep it product-centric: "Redwood Inference now available via marketplace X" with a link to docs and a quick start. Partnerships team, we'll want a 1-paragraph co-branded blurb customers can reuse.

publish-bot: Created task MP-2307: marketplace-assets-and-launch-copy. Assigned to nina-partnerships. Link: https://phab/redwood/MP-2307

ownen-cloud: Operational note: Azure requires a plan-level SKU CSV; AWS wants an S3 assets prefix that matches offer alias. I'll draft a checklist and a tiny Terraform example to show required variables.

tess-legal: Also flagging trademark usage in announcement. Send me the draft blurb and Ill confirm approved phrasing.

nina-partnerships: Action list: owen build validation script + checklist by Thu; tess drop EULA + copy variants by Wed; mike craft 1-paragraph co-brand blurb by Wed EOD. Quick sync Friday 10am PT to confirm ready-for-submission.

mike-product: I'll post the draft blurb in #marketing-drafts for review and tag @tess-legal.

nina-partnerships: Thanks all. If anything stalls tag me and put blockers in MP-2307. Closing thread for now. :tada:
